model: proper cubic rotations; one fixed root; finite face-distance corona exact cover

method.continuation_solver: exact conflict-backjumping GCTS with fixed outer placements
method.cut: a fixed-placement obstruction clause extracted only after exact continuation exhaustion
method.symmetry_closure: every sound cut closed under the root polycube stabilizer
method.one_step_coverability: optional exact necessary-condition encoding requires every next-ring cell to retain at least one placement compatible with the selected outer patch; conflict-set dominance removes locally redundant candidate placements
method.pair_coverability: optional exact necessary-condition encoding requires selected next-ring cell pairs to retain mutually compatible placement choices; new incompatible pairs can be symmetry-closed and staged between CEGAR trials
method.bounded_copy_semantics: UNSAT with max_placements set exhausts only that copy-count stratum and is never classified as non-tiling

pair_coverability.lazy_gcts_outer_ab_conclusion: neutral: both seeded 5,000,000-node searches remained incomplete and all 46 newly encountered continuations had simpler immediate obstructions

interpretation: The positive control shows that low-copy CEGAR can leave the dense dead-state basin and recover a known extendable stratum. For p9-42947, every one of 281 proposed radius-four patches is exactly obstructed at radius five, including 31 economical patches and thirteen 63-copy patches. The one-step filter removes immediate dead targets; the pairwise filter then removes the next 2–4-node failure class and makes two new proposals require five-node continuation proofs. Those states expose 14 new incompatible cell pairs, growing the exact symmetry-closed pair set from 72 to 114. Lazy GCTS pair analysis independently replays both pair obstructions and shrinks one exact conflict clause from seven placements to four; a seeded 5,000,000-node A/B run is neutral because every newly encountered continuation has a simpler immediate obstruction. Four 114-pair solves time out, so the radius-four state space remains unexhausted. These results prove neither non-tiling nor aperiodicity.
